## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- DD2: LiteLLM transport for Anthropic + OpenAI detected and documented

## Implementation
Create tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_transport_verify.py: pytest test that uses importlib to verify providers/anthropic.py is loadable, probes for HTTP transport (httpx, aiohttp), writes transport-report.md to tmp_path (not fixtures/). Also create committed snapshot: tests/fixtures/ci-review-transport-report.md.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] bash tests/run-all.sh passes
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] test_litellm_transport_verified function exists in test file
  Verify: grep -q "def test_litellm_transport_verified" tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_transport_verify.py
- [ ] test writes to tmp_path not fixtures/ directly
  Verify: grep -q "tmp_path" tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_transport_verify.py
- [ ] committed transport report exists and is non-empty
  Verify: test -s tests/fixtures/ci-review-transport-report.md
- [ ] report contains transport information
  Verify: grep -qi "httpx\|aiohttp\|transport" tests/fixtures/ci-review-transport-report.md

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user
